question: Should the stored probe body of 2026-10-30 that evidence row 4 of crawler-scraper/firecrawl-keyless cites (capture sha256:5b31bf16bc7ecf9d25f65bf75d09fe9c74fb97fae071166273978dc85a61b182) be rewritten with the token of its signup_url link replaced by [redacted]?
why: The signup_url in that body is a firecrawl.dev/k/<token> link. The API source (apps/api/src/lib/keyless-signup-link.ts) builds the token from the caller's IPv4 address, encrypted with a vendor key, so every probe from one address returns the same token: a stable pseudonym of the probing host's egress address (lane rule 5). This unit registered the probe record of 2026-11-01 and not the body it saved, for that reason. A rewrite changes the capture hash, so the evidence row would cite a new capture; the auth.ts quote registered by this unit carries the same message sentence.
